title: OSINT external recon
preconditions: challenge defines the allowed public sources
steps: Pivot on the exact identifier: `whois`, DNS (`dig`), `crt.sh`, `subfinder`, and passive DNS/archive sources.
Search the handle across platforms with `sherlock`/`maigret`; check profile metadata, avatars, and reused usernames.
Use the Wayback Machine and Google/Bing dorks for deleted pages, documents, and exposed metadata.
Corroborate every answer with at least two independent sources; do not contact real people or bypass logins.
falsifier: No public record links the identifier to the requested fact, or the only source is an unverified snippet.
